body:
## What's Changed

| Linux    | hyperfine-v1.20.0-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz | glibc 2.17 |

A task list:

- [x] Ship the release
- [ ] Update the docs
- [ ] Announce it

Some inline constructs: ~~this was removed~~, thanks to @sharkdp and @cellar-app
for the report, and see https://github.com/sharkdp/hyperfine/issues/1 for the
original thread.
